rows.section: Personal income tax (податок на доходи фізичних осіб)
rows.label: Wages and other employment income
rows.basis: Taxable income of an individual, per month (withheld by the employer)
rows.note: One flat rate, with no tax-free allowance other than the tax social benefit for low wages. The 5% military levy is charged on the same income, so 23% in total is withheld from pay. Individuals are taxed separately (no joint filing).
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Податковий кодекс України № 2755-VI, art. 167 (редакція від 17.09.2026; read from the Internet Archive capture of 13.10.2026)

rows.section: Military levy (військовий збір)
rows.label: Military levy on wages and other income taxed with personal income tax
rows.note: withheld by the employer with income tax
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Закон № 4015-IX від 10.10.2024 «Про внесення змін до Податкового кодексу України ...» (набрання чинності 01.12.2024); Податковий кодекс України, розділ XX, підрозділ 10, пункт 16-1 (редакція від 17.09.2026); read from Internet Archive captures of 09.10.2026 and 13.10.2026

rows.section: Military levy (військовий збір)
rows.label: Legal basis and start date
rows.value: Tax Code section XX, subsection 10, para 16-1, in the wording of Law 4015-IX of 10 October 2024, in force from 1 December 2024
rows.note: The levy is temporary: it applies until the Verkhovna Rada decides the armed forces reform is complete; for single-tax payers it applies from 1 January 2025 until 31 December of the third year after martial law ends.
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Закон № 4015-IX від 10.10.2024 «Про внесення змін до Податкового кодексу України ...» (набрання чинності 01.12.2024); Податковий кодекс України, розділ XX, підрозділ 10, пункт 16-1 (редакція від 17.09.2026); read from Internet Archive captures of 09.10.2026 and 13.10.2026

rows.section: Military levy (військовий збір)
rows.label: Rate for military personnel and staff of the defence and security forces
rows.note: The levy is temporary: it applies until the Verkhovna Rada decides the armed forces reform is complete; for single-tax payers it applies from 1 January 2025 until 31 December of the third year after martial law ends.

rows.section: Military levy (військовий збір)
rows.label: Rate from 1 January of the year after the third calendar year after martial law ends
rows.note: The levy is temporary: it applies until the Verkhovna Rada decides the armed forces reform is complete; for single-tax payers it applies from 1 January 2025 until 31 December of the third year after martial law ends.
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Закон № 4015-IX від 10.10.2024 «Про внесення змін до Податкового кодексу України ...» (набрання чинності 01.12.2024); Податковий кодекс України, розділ XX, підрозділ 10, пункт 16-1 (редакція від 17.09.2026); read from Internet Archive captures of 09.10.2026 and 13.10.2026

rows.label: Combined income tax and military levy on wages
rows.note: The levy is temporary: it applies until the Verkhovna Rada decides the armed forces reform is complete; for single-tax payers it applies from 1 January 2025 until 31 December of the third year after martial law ends.
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Закон № 4015-IX від 10.10.2024 «Про внесення змін до Податкового кодексу України ...» (набрання чинності 01.12.2024); Податковий кодекс України, розділ XX, підрозділ 10, пункт 16-1 (редакція від 17.09.2026); read from Internet Archive captures of 09.10.2026 and 13.10.2026

rows.section: Military levy (військовий збір)
rows.label: Sole proprietors in single-tax groups 1, 2 and 4: military levy per month (10% of the minimum wage)
rows.note: The levy is temporary: it applies until the Verkhovna Rada decides the armed forces reform is complete; for single-tax payers it applies from 1 January 2025 until 31 December of the third year after martial law ends.

rows.label: Sole proprietors in single-tax group 3: military levy on income
rows.note: e-residents are exempt

rows.section: Tax social benefit (податкова соціальна пільга)
rows.label: Basic benefit, per month (50% of the subsistence minimum for an able-bodied person)
rows.note: It reduces the income-tax base, not the military levy base. 2026 amounts follow from the subsistence minimum of UAH 3,328 set by the State Budget Law 2026.
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Податковий кодекс України № 2755-VI, art. 169 (редакція від 17.09.2026; read from the Internet Archive capture of 13.10.2026); Закон № 4695-IX «Про Державний бюджет України на 2026 рік», art. 7

rows.section: Tax social benefit (податкова соціальна пільга)
rows.label: Monthly wage limit: the benefit applies only if wages do not exceed
rows.note: 1.4 × the subsistence minimum, rounded to the nearest UAH 10
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Податковий кодекс України № 2755-VI, art. 169 (редакція від 17.09.2026; read from the Internet Archive capture of 13.10.2026); Закон № 4695-IX «Про Державний бюджет України на 2026 рік», art. 7

rows.section: Tax social benefit (податкова соціальна пільга)
rows.label: Benefit for a parent with two or more children under 18, per child, as a share of the basic benefit
rows.note: the wage limit is multiplied by the number of children
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Податковий кодекс України № 2755-VI, art. 169 (редакція від 17.09.2026; read from the Internet Archive capture of 13.10.2026); Закон № 4695-IX «Про Державний бюджет України на 2026 рік», art. 7

rows.section: Tax social benefit (податкова соціальна пільга)
rows.label: Higher benefit (single parents, students, disability groups I and II and others), as a share of the basic benefit
rows.note: It reduces the income-tax base, not the military levy base. 2026 amounts follow from the subsistence minimum of UAH 3,328 set by the State Budget Law 2026.
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Податковий кодекс України № 2755-VI, art. 169 (редакція від 17.09.2026; read from the Internet Archive capture of 13.10.2026); Закон № 4695-IX «Про Державний бюджет України на 2026 рік», art. 7

rows.section: Tax social benefit (податкова соціальна пільга)
rows.label: Subsistence minimum for an able-bodied person, per month, from 1 January 2026
rows.note: It reduces the income-tax base, not the military levy base. 2026 amounts follow from the subsistence minimum of UAH 3,328 set by the State Budget Law 2026.
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Закон № 4695-IX від 03.12.2025 «Про Державний бюджет України на 2026 рік», art. 7 (read from Internet Archive captures of 04.01.2026 (print text) and 19.05.2026: 'чинний, поточна редакція — Прийняття від 03.12.2025')

rows.section: Tax social benefit (податкова соціальна пільга)
rows.label: How it is applied
rows.value: Reduces the monthly taxable wage from one employer, on the employee's application to that employer (Tax Code art. 169.2)
rows.note: It reduces the income-tax base, not the military levy base. 2026 amounts follow from the subsistence minimum of UAH 3,328 set by the State Budget Law 2026.
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Податковий кодекс України № 2755-VI, art. 169 (редакція від 17.09.2026; read from the Internet Archive capture of 13.10.2026); Закон № 4695-IX «Про Державний бюджет України на 2026 рік», art. 7

rows.section: Employee contributions
rows.label: Unified social contribution (ЄСВ), employee share
rows.note: the employer pays the ЄСВ on top of gross pay; nothing is withheld from the employee for it
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Закон № 2464-VI «Про збір та облік єдиного внеску на загальнообов'язкове державне соціальне страхування», art. 4, 7, 8 (редакція від 26.01.2026, basis Law 4697-IX; read from the Internet Archive capture of 08.10.2026)

rows.section: Employee contributions
rows.label: Personal income tax withheld from pay
rows.note: Employees pay no social contribution of their own: the 22% ЄСВ is the employer's. Withholding from pay is income tax (18%) and the military levy (5%).
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Податковий кодекс України № 2755-VI, art. 167 (редакція від 17.09.2026; read from the Internet Archive capture of 13.10.2026)

rows.label: Rate for employees with disabilities
rows.note: One contribution covers pension, unemployment, sickness and maternity and accident insurance; there is no separate employee share. Collected by the State Tax Service (ЄСВ Law art. 8).
rows.source_title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Закон № 2464-VI «Про збір та облік єдиного внеску на загальнообов'язкове державне соціальне страхування», art. 4, 7, 8 (редакція від 26.01.2026, basis Law 4697-IX; read from the Internet Archive capture of 08.10.2026)

rows.section: Employer contribution: unified social contribution (ЄСВ)
rows.label: Diia City residents
rows.value: The minimum insurance contribution (22% of the minimum wage) per employee or gig specialist, whatever the pay
rows.note: One contribution covers pension, unemployment, sickness and maternity and accident insurance; there is no separate employee share. Collected by the State Tax Service (ЄСВ Law art. 8).

rows.section: Employer contribution: unified social contribution (ЄСВ)
rows.label: Second jobs and contracts with non-fixed hours
rows.value: 22% of the actual pay, without the minimum-wage floor
rows.note: One contribution covers pension, unemployment, sickness and maternity and accident insurance; there is no separate employee share. Collected by the State Tax Service (ЄСВ Law art. 8).

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: E-residents (foreign non-residents)
rows.value: Single-tax group 3 at 5% on income from clients outside Ukraine, up to 1167 minimum wages a year; no military levy; e-resident status does not make them Ukrainian tax residents
rows.note: Most freelancers use the single tax (group 2 or 3). Ukraine has no digital-nomad visa and no special regime for people who move there.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Diia City (companies, not individuals)
rows.value: 5% income tax and 5% military levy on the pay of employees and gig specialists of resident companies
rows.note: Most freelancers use the single tax (group 2 or 3). Ukraine has no digital-nomad visa and no special regime for people who move there.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad or remote-work visa
rows.value: None: the long-term (D) visa is issued only on listed grounds (work permit, family, study and programmes, investment, missions); none covers remote work for foreign employers or clients
rows.note: Most freelancers use the single tax (group 2 or 3). Ukraine has no digital-nomad visa and no special regime for people who move there.

rows.label: Where visas are issued
rows.value: Embassies and consulates of Ukraine (Ministry of Foreign Affairs); a D visa leads to a temporary residence permit
rows.note: Most freelancers use the single tax (group 2 or 3). Ukraine has no digital-nomad visa and no special regime for people who move there.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Tax on a foreigner living in Ukraine
rows.value: Tax resident with a home in Ukraine or the centre of vital interests there, or after 183 days in the tax year; residents are taxed on worldwide income with no exemption period for foreign income
rows.note: Most freelancers use the single tax (group 2 or 3). Ukraine has no digital-nomad visa and no special regime for people who move there.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound or expat tax regime
rows.value: None: residents are taxed at the normal rates from arrival; the Tax Code has no reduced rate, exemption or flat tax for new residents
rows.note: Most freelancers use the single tax (group 2 or 3). Ukraine has no digital-nomad visa and no special regime for people who move there.
